# #4577: Patch: the Infinite Assault, C1, the set, its tags and the Assault Core
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part of #4576. Card part **C1** of the Infinite Assault's set: build every card below, base and Radiant, as a card of a held single-player set. Players see nothing of it until the release (R).

The plan of record is [`docs/infinite-assault.md`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk/docs/infinite-assault.md): on `main` once C1 merges, and until then on the planning branch `claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk`. Where it and SPEC disagree, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). Read its IA11 (the set, its ids, its hold, its tags and the design rules) before you start.

Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10), its rows for a card of a set that has not shipped above all, and `spec/README.md` with the sections and rulings the cards touch (rule 1).

Write each card's §8.13 row in `spec/08-catalog.md` first, under the heading C1 adds: it is the only source of card text (CLAUDE.md), and the catalog entry and the script follow it.

## The foundation this part also lays (IA11)

- **The set row:** `InfiniteAssault = "Infinite Assault"` at the end of `set_table!`
  (`crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs`, R3114000), segment `infiniteassault`, abbreviation `IA`,
  `shadow_ban_share` `None`, single-player (R1846001). Never move a row.
- **Its hold.** R1846001 says a single-player set built card by card before its mode ships needs a hold of
  its own, added by the issue that builds it. Default: a new `SetStage`, single-player and held, which no
  pool reaches (`everySet` included), opened in tests by the testkit's `preview_sets` as a held set is,
  and played by `cargo jackioh fuzz` as every held set is; the release (R) turns it to `SinglePlayer`.
  Amend R1846001 (and the test that pins `SINGLE_PLAYER_SETS` to Boss and Boss-X) with a ruling in this
  issue's block.
- **The tags:** every card of the set carries the existing `AI` tag (an AI generated card, R1421), plus
  its doctrine's tag. Declare the eight doctrine tags (Hallucination, Overclock, Batch, Recursion,
  Jailbreak, Firewall, Scraper, Singularity) and `Commander` now, for the later parts, with whatever the
  server needs to admit a new tag (a migration if its schema lists tags; `crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh`).
- **The census entry** (`crates/cards/src/census.rs`), the scripts folder
  `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/`, the fixture rows' set, and §8.13's heading in
  `spec/08-catalog.md` with the set's introduction (IA11's fiction, ids and numbers) and the rows of the
  cards below; each later card part adds its own rows under it.
- **The plan onto `main`:** copy `docs/infinite-assault.md` from the planning branch verbatim, correcting only
  what this build decided otherwise, and link it from `spec/README.md`'s map line for §8.
- Run the workspace tests, which regenerate `apps/web/src/wire/generated/SetName.ts` (and the tag type);
  commit the diff. Nothing counts the set in the shipped totals (`set_is_open`, `setShips`).

## The cards

Card numbers are written `IA-n` here; in the spec and the catalog they are the set's own (`IA #25`, `infiniteassault-025`, its tokens `infiniteassault-025-1`).

#### IA12.1 Assault Core, IA-1–IA-24

The Assault's war machine: Drones, Created cards and the factory that writes them. No doctrine tag; every
deck may deal them.

- **IA-1 Seed Drone** — (1) Unit, Common, 2/2. Cry: Add a random Common Infinite Assault card to your hand. *Radiant:* 4/4. Cry: Add a random Rare Infinite Assault card to your hand.
- **IA-2 Scrap Prototype** — (0) Unit, Common, 1/2. Death: Shuffle a copy of this with +1/+1 into your deck. *Radiant:* 2/4. Death: Shuffle two copies of this with +2/+2 into your deck.
- **IA-3 Assault Trooper** — (1) Unit, Common, 3/2. Rush. *Radiant:* 6/4. Rush, First Strike.
- **IA-4 Wave Spawner** — (2) Unit, Common, 3/4. End of turn: If you played a Created card this turn, summon a Drone. *Radiant:* 6/8. End of turn: If you played a Created card this turn, summon two Drones.
  - **IA-4.1 Drone** — token, (1) Unit, 1/1.
- **IA-5 Generated Filler** — (1) Spell, Common. Add two random (1)-Cost Infinite Assault Units to your hand. They're Temporary. *Radiant:* … They cost (0) and are Temporary.
- **IA-6 Hotfix** — (1) Spell, Common. Give a friendly Unit +2/+2. If it's Created, draw a card. *Radiant:* +4/+4 and Divine Shield; if it's Created, draw a card.
- **IA-7 Bulk Order** — (2) Spell, Common. Summon three Drones. *Radiant:* Summon three Radiant Drones with Rush.
- **IA-8 Firing Solution** — (1) Spell, Common. Deal 3 damage to a Unit. If it dies, add a random Infinite Assault Spell to your hand. *Radiant:* Deal 6 damage …
- **IA-9 Heavy Lifter Mk.II** — (3) Unit, Common, 5/7. Taunt. Cry: Give your other Created Units +1/+1. *Radiant:* 10/14. … +2/+2.
- **IA-10 Assault Carrier** — (4) Unit, Common, 7/8. Death: Summon two Drone Escorts. *Radiant:* 14/16. Death: Summon two Radiant Drone Escorts.
  - **IA-10.1 Drone Escort** — token, (2) Unit, 3/3.
- **IA-11 Quickgen Turret** — (2) Unit, Rare, 2/5. Ranged. Start of turn: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy for each Created card in your hand. *Radiant:* 4/10. … 2 damage …
- **IA-12 Recompile** — (1) Spell, Rare. Transform a friendly Unit into a random Infinite Assault Unit that costs (1) more. *Radiant:* … (2) more.
- **IA-13 Training Run** — (2) Spell, Rare. Discover an Infinite Assault card. It costs (2) less. *Radiant:* Discover two.
- **IA-14 Overflow Error** — (1) Trap, Rare. Reveals when your opponent plays their third card in a turn: Deal 3 damage to their hero. They discard a random card. *Radiant:* 6 damage; two cards.
- **IA-15 Drone Foundry** — (2) Field Spell, Rare. Start of turn: Summon a Drone. Then, if you have 4 or more Drones, give your Drones +1/+1. *Radiant:* Summon two Drones …
- **IA-16 Benchmark Run** — (1) Spell, Rare. Set a friendly Unit's Attack to the highest Attack and its Health to the highest Health among enemy Units. *Radiant:* … and give it Rush.
- **IA-17 Cluster Drone** — (2) Unit, Rare, 3/2. Death: Deal 2 damage to every enemy Unit. *Radiant:* 6/4. … 4 damage …
- **IA-18 Prompt Engineer** — (2) Unit, Rare, 2/4. Your Created cards cost (1) less, but not less than (1). *Radiant:* 4/8. Your Created cards cost (1) less, but not less than (1), and your Created Units have +1/+1.
- **IA-19 Infinite Scroll** — (3) Spell, Epic. Draw three cards. Shuffle a copy of this into your deck. *Radiant:* Draw four cards. Shuffle a copy of this into your deck; it costs (1) less.
- **IA-20 Synthetic Data** — (2) Spell, Epic. Fill your hand with random Infinite Assault cards. They're Temporary. *Radiant:* … They're Temporary and cost (1) less.
- **IA-21 Endless Production Line** — (4) Field Spell, Epic. End of turn: Summon a random Infinite Assault Unit that costs (2) or less. *Radiant:* … summon two.
- **IA-22 Assault Mainframe** — (4) Unit, Epic, 6/10. Taunt. Aura: Your Created Units have +2/+2. *Radiant:* 12/20. … +4/+4.
- **IA-23 The Generator** — (3) Unit, Legendary, 4/6. Start of turn: Add a random Infinite Assault card to your hand. It costs (0). *Radiant:* 8/12. … two random Infinite Assault cards …
- **IA-24 Mass Deployment** — (4) Spell, Legendary. Summon a random Infinite Assault Unit of each Cost from (1) to (3). They have Rush. *Radiant:* … They're Radiant and have Rush.

## The design rules (IA11)

**The design rules every card part keeps.**

1. **Real cards.** Each card is legal in an ordinary game and plays the same in any mode; none reads the
   mode or its level. Commons to Legendaries of the doctrines and the Core sit on JackiOh's curve (costs
   (0) to (4); about 4 stats at (1), 8 at (2), 12 at (3), 16 at (4) for a Unit with little text, less with
   more), so they can be reused. Commander cards are boss cards, above the curve on purpose.
2. **Spicy, never unfair.** Swingy and rule-bending is the point, but every threat has an answer the player
   can see coming: a countdown is shown, a wall can be killed, a bluff can be called. Nothing makes the
   player lose with no counterplay, and nothing locks them out of playing for a turn they can't foresee
   (Kill Switch, IA-140, fires on a third card, which the player may choose not to play).
3. **Expressible.** The text uses verbs, keywords and filters the engine has (§6); where a card needs a new
   one, its part adds it by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, with its test. Numbers are `params` (`{damage}`),
   never literals (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
4. **Radiant is about twice the base face** (R275): doubled stats and a better line, never stats alone for
   a Unit with text. Each part writes its `docs/radiant-audit.md` rows.
5. **"Infinite Assault card"** in a card's text is a pool that names the set, which reaches the set while
   it is held (R1846001: a pool that names its set keeps to it). "Created" is the engine's Created mark.
6. **The AI must pilot it.** A card whose prompt the AI can't answer well is fixed or redesigned in its
   part, not shipped hoping.
7. **The part may tune.** A part may change a number, a word or a Radiant line where the engine or balance
   asks, keeping the card's role and its spice, and says so in its pull request; a bigger change goes in a
   ruling note.

## Done when

- `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (CLAUDE.md rule 10), and its files were touched row by row for a
  held set.
- Every card's script (`crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/cNNN_slug.rs`) plays its base and
  Radiant faces by its §8.13 row, with tests in the same file for both (rule 6); its catalog entry, census
  counts, fixture row, radiant-audit row, `card-text.yaml` entry (flavour, voice, Chinese), `card-audio.json5`
  entry and FX line are written.
- Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note in the part's own issue block, a test named after
  it, and a paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md` (rule 3).
- Every new prompt is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout; `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200
  --cards <each new id>` is green.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes, and `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `names --check`
  pass.
- Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).
- The pull request says `Closes` this issue and `Part of` the tracker, and merges with `rust`, `web`, `e2e smoke`, `db` and `bot selftest` green (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

Blocked by nothing: it goes first.
